title: ID0455221-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R4 170001557] Charging Issue
description:
Reported Behavior/Issue: Charging Issue
Solution: as the charger is offline, we asked the requester to perform a log analysis and inform us. Waiting for an answer to present a solution to the customer. customer asked if they should perform a reboot of the system. we said yes in order to see if the issue is related to the router. waiting for answer from the cst to see if issue is solved. The router has to be identified by SSH.

Dear Chloe,
Both routers (siemens backend XF3 and customer backend XF4) are having some issues showing the webinterface. I don't want to factory reset remotely because the charger can go out of order after it.
I recommend to have someone on site doing it. It's necessary to factory reset both routers and configure again using our software Sicharge D Companion Tool. In case you don't have, I can send it.

Be aware that this charger is no longer in warranty and the decision to replace relies on you.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0455221-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R4 170001557] Charging Issue CRM:03098000020
additional_info.body:
Dear Bob,
You can close the Authentication pop-up. Is only used for Firmware Management but you don't have access to it. All other functions will work.
Instructions to factory reset the routers:
Remove the metal plate that covers the routers
With the routers power ON press the reset button located on the back next to the antenas, press for 10 sec.
Remove the Ethernet cable on the WAN port of router XF3 and connect your laptop there.
Change your IP settings since the router will change to default IP 192.168.1.1
You can set multiple IPs, follow instructions in the pictures above. PC will change automatically and you can leave it after for later use.
Open your Companion tool and go to Teltonika RUT-240/RUT-241 (SIEMENS) [XF3]
Wait some minutes for the factory reset to finish and and press CHECK
If it's ready will appear a button CONFIGURE. Press it
Wait some minutes and press CHECK until there is a message saying LOOKS GOOD
Router is ready, connect back the original cable to WAN port of router XF3 and repeat the same process for XF4.
After configure both routers reboot the charger
Check the performance to see if routers are working properly or not. If not, router replacement is needed.
Let me know if this information is clear to you or additional support is needed.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
mailto:joao.louro-cardoso@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
